name: task-attack
task: Audit the algorithmic task generators for remaining leakage, trivial shortcuts, split contamination, or invalid claims. Give up to five concrete findings with severity and cheapest discriminating control. The model is a zero-boundary symmetric radius-one NCA with no diffusion; all input tokens are visible at tick zero and scored only where mask=1. Distinguish intended retrieval from answer leakage. Legacy Text/Dyck are excluded from clean experiments.

name: horizon-attack
task: Review this existing horizon training implementation. Identify silent no-ops, RNG confounds, loss-weighting problems and what must be corrected before claiming horizon robustness. Return concrete findings and minimal tests; no architecture additions.

name: minimalist-attack
task: Independently critique the Titan NCA hypothesis that horizon-specific accuracy peaks demonstrate paced computation. No clean results exist yet. Propose three competing mundane mechanisms and one cheap discriminating experiment each. Specify a minimal conventional competitor and fair parameter/update/runtime comparisons. Treat bound increments as distinct from bounded state.
